prior_authorship: Reviewer authored the old60ae late-finalizer support baseline. This review covers only the new build_workflow carrier/helper code; old late-finalizer schemas and baseline publication business semantics are not re-reviewed.
assigned_scope: Exact basename/strict-size whitelist and original raw size/SHA preservation.
Streaming deterministic gzip creation and verified roundtrip before atomic carrier installation.
Mapping actual carrier repository paths separately from unchanged original raw manifest identities.
Restore path validation, no-clobber, symlink/FIFO/nonregular rejection, bounded reads/expansion and hash/CRC rejection.
Hash binding of this new helper in the publisher and consistency of the supplied isolated fixture evidence.
separate_root_scope_not_duplicated: Parent root reviews whole baseline business/AST preservation, final publisher integration and production publication authorization. No new carrier or actual production compression claim is made by this static partition review.

static_checks.raw_validation: Original raw record remains its original relative path/byte count/SHA. Creation hashes/counts all raw bytes while streaming and rejects shrink/growth/mismatch before link. Existing carriers require a current source raw digest check as well. No raw file is rewritten, deleted, parsed into an evidence substitute or assigned a compressed hash.

gzip_creation.existing_valid_carrier_retained_without_: Existing carrier is accepted only after regular-file, size, fixed first header and full lossless raw identity checks; its actual compressed identity is then recorded in the immutable mapping.

static_checks.partial_failure_boundary: An invalid file is never atomically installed. If a later row changes after initial preflight, earlier verified rows may remain in the new output directory and the command fails; no whole-directory rollback is claimed. Recovery does not assemble the small unchanged source/evidence files automatically.

fixture_evidence_reused_not_rerun.review_method: Read tests and actual immutable log/validation hashes. Did not import either candidate or execute the fixtures.
representative_cases: small and Lean source exact-copy behavior
CRC corruption and truncated gzip with recomputed compressed digest
exact expected expansion and aggregate cap
existing output and raw destination preservation

observational_limits: Synthetic author fixtures establish the reported isolated test result, not production batch56 compression ratio or actual carrier size.
This review statically checks dirfd/no-follow/no-clobber behavior and reads the existing symlink fixtures. It does not claim a new independent concurrent filesystem-race execution.
Restoration authenticates raw and compressed payloads against the supplied mapping. The published mapping and its original-publication SHA remain part of the external publication integrity chain.
The helper does not claim complete formal-project reproduction or theorem acceptance; source/proof/log bytes and original417-owned acceptance remain separate evidence.
